read.title: Shipping Documents for Order #2047
read.text:
Dear Mr. Nguyen,

As requested, please find attached the draft shipping documents for Order #2047: the commercial invoice, the packing list, and the certificate of origin.

Could you check the consignee name and address before we finalize them? Your customs broker mentioned that the address must match your import license exactly.

Once you confirm, we will send the original documents by courier, and scanned copies will follow by email. Please reply at your earliest convenience so that the goods can clear customs without delay.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.task: 해외 바이어가 선적 서류를 요청했어요. 상업 송장과 포장 명세서 초안을 첨부했다고 알리고, 내용 확인을 빨리 부탁하는 답장을 써 보세요.
write.en: Reply to a buyer who asked for shipping documents: say you attached the draft invoice and packing list, and ask them to check them soon.
write.model:
Dear Ms. Park,

As requested, I have attached the draft commercial invoice and packing list for your order. Please check the product codes and quantities at your earliest convenience. Once you confirm, we will issue the final documents and the certificate of origin.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
